description.value: Laughing Oyster is an iconic seafood restaurant perched on Okeover Arm near Lund at the northern terminus of BC's Sunshine Coast, renowned for scratch-made dishes featuring locally sourced seafood prepared with a signature searing and spice method. The restaurant offers a stunning ocean-view setting and an expansive menu spanning spot prawns, halibut, bouillabaisse, and oysters, with ocean-view cabin accommodations now available on site. A shuttle service from Powell River and Lund is offered through a partner operator, making it accessible for visitors without vehicles.

address.value: 10052 Malaspina Road, Powell River, B.C. V8A 0G3
